name: @aphrody/bun-forge
description: yolo forge: builds the aphrody-labs/bun fork on a fresh Linux machine, one temporary checkout per commit

scripts.compile:all: bun build ./src/main.ts --compile --minify --bytecode --format=esm --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/bun-forge-linux-x64 && bun build ./src/main.ts --compile --minify --bytecode --format=esm --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/bun-forge-linux-arm64
